wu: Warm-up: 'Phonics Jump' — Teacher says a letter sound (e.g., 'a'), students jump and say a word (e.g., 'apple'). Repeat for A-F sounds.
wuAlt: Warm-up: 'Sound Bingo' — Students have bingo cards with A-F pictures; teacher calls sounds, students mark matches.
Warm-up: 'Pass the Sound' — Students pass a ball and say a word for the called sound (e.g., 'b' for 'ball').
pres: Presentation: Use flashcards for A-F (apple, ball, cat, dog, egg, fish) and ch/sh (chair, shop). Model 'a is for apple', 'ch is for chair'. Students repeat and point.
presAlt: Presentation: 'Phonics Story' — Show a short story with A-F and ch/sh words; teacher reads, students repeat sounds.
Presentation: 'Realia Show' — Bring real objects (apple, ball, chair, shop toy); name them, emphasize sounds.
prac: Guided Practice: 'Pair Picture Dictation' — Student A says a word (e.g., 'fish'), Student B draws it. Swap roles. Teacher monitors for correct sounds.
pracAlt: Guided Practice: 'Word Sort' — Students sort ch/sh word cards into two columns; teacher checks pronunciation.
Guided Practice: 'Sound Hopscotch' — Draw hopscotch with A-F sounds; students jump and say a word for each sound.
ls: Listening Slot: 'Sound Hunt' — Teacher plays a recording with ch/sh words (e.g., 'shop', 'chair'). Students raise hands when they hear the sound and say the word.
re: Reactivation Game: 'Turkey Tag' — One student is 'it' (turkey), others run. If tagged, they say 'I am thankful for...'.
prod: Production Task: 'Gratitude Turkey Craft' — Students make a turkey with paper feathers. Each feather has a sentence: 'I am thankful for...'. Share in groups.
rw: Reading/Writing Slot: 'Trace and Write' — Students trace ch/sh words (fish, chair, shop) from the board, then copy them into notebooks.
st: Story/Song + Goodbye: Sing 'The Thanksgiving Turkey' song with actions. End with 'Goodbye Song + sticker chart + high-five line.'
g: Jump and say a word for the called sound.
Draw words said by a partner.
Tagged students say 'I am thankful for...'.
Sort ch/sh word cards into columns.
diff: Support: Trace words with dotted lines.
hw: Find and label 5 pictures of A-F and ch/sh words from magazines.
Say 3 'I am thankful for...' sentences at home to your family.
Draw a picture of your favorite ch/sh word and write it below.
tip: Use real objects (like a toy shop or chair) to make phonics tangible; connect gratitude to local values like family and community.
